newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures close higher across board.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures close higher across board.

text.p: Rubber futures closed higher across the board on some late local buying interest in line with higher prices in Japan, brokers said on Tuesday.
They said prices in Tokyo and Kobe were firmer across the board on technical trade and bargain hunting, supported by firmer prices in rubber-producing countries.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning due mainly to an absence of fresh incentives. But prices rose slightly in the afternoon as some late local buying interest emerged in sympathy with higher prices in Tokyo and Kobe. Volume was moderate," a local dealer said.
At around 0945 GMT, April/June RSS3 rose 2.75 cents to 134.25 U.S. cents a kg.
December RSS1 rose three cents to 191.50 Singapore cents (US$1.36) a kg.
October TSR20 rose 2.50 cents to 178.50 Singapore cents (US$1.27) a kg.
